connector.name: VerifyRef
connector.registryDescription: AI agent recruiting: talent pool match, reference checks, credit packs via Stripe MPP
connector.summary: Hosted at verifyref.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package verifyref-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.verifyref, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: VERIFYREF_API_KEY
env.description: rc_test_ or rc_live_ API key from https://verifyref.com/team/api
